ruleDefinitions.name: XBAP Execution From Uncommon Locations Via PresentationHost.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of ".xbap" (Browser Applications) files via PresentationHost.EXE from an uncommon location. These files can be abused to run malicious ".xbap" files any bypass AWL

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\presentationhost\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "PresentationHost\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.xbap.*")) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files.*")))
